services.name: Shared Hosted (Office Communication System)
services.shortDescription: Cloud-based PBX with zero hardware hassle and instant scalability.
services.extendedDescription: A cloud-powered PBX system that eliminates hardware investments and maintenance headaches. This multi-tenant solution offers enterprise-grade features such as IVR, smart call routing, conferencing, and real-time analytics—all accessible from anywhere. With built-in redundancy, encryption, and a 99.9% uptime SLA, you can scale instantly while enjoying predictable monthly costs. Ideal if you seek flexibility, mobility, and cost efficiency.

services.name: Dedicated Hosted (Office Communication System)
services.shortDescription: Fully managed cloud PBX dedicated to your business with exclusive resources.

Unlike shared solutions, this service provides isolated resources, stronger compliance, and complete customization of call flows, integrations, and analytics. With enterprise-grade performance, encrypted communication, and disaster recovery, you enjoy reliability and security at scale. Best suited if you require high performance, advanced integrations, and guaranteed resource availability.

Ideal if you prioritize reliability, customization, and in-house management of customer care operations.
